newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed, top shares active.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed, top shares active.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Friday as activity slowed down with only drugs firm Pliva and Zagrebacka Banka trading higher volumes.
* Four of 15 traded issues rose, five fell and six were flat.
* Volume and turnover were halved at 16,455 units and 16.1 million kuna respectively.
* Top gainer ship repair company Viktor Lenac climbed 26 kuna or 20.2 percent to 155 kuna on volume of 1,000 shares.
* Biggest decliner brewery Karlovacka Pivovara lost 30 kuna or 5.6 percent to 510 with 700 shares sold.
* Pliva, selling 5,522 shares, was the most active issue. It rose 10 kuna to 510.
